description: When the developer asks for a demo's link (to post it, embed it or send it): gives the demo its public share link and the player to embed, the way Share link does in tday.com, and returns them. The link follows every new take. A re-record made through a teammate's prompt waits for the team before it replaces the video people see: with publish true, and only when the developer says so after watching it, this publishes that take first. A private link is left private (only someone in tday.com makes it public). Needs the developer's own tday.com login, not a capture prompt's token. The projectId is in demo_upload's editor link (tday.com/studio/<projectId>) or demo_features.

projectId.description: The demo (its projectId, as demo_features or the prompt names it)

publish.description: Publish the take that waits for the team first (only when the developer said so)

name: demo_share
title: Publish a demo and get its share link
